# `interaction`

Something a character can do to a thing: its reach, time, conditions and effects (16 §3.1).

## Fields

Besides these, a definition takes the [keys every definition carries](README.md#keys-every-definition-carries).

- `name` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a menu calls it.
- `target` (one of `"element"`, `"entity"` ([`TargetKind`](#targetkind)); optional): What it is done to: `element` (the default) or `entity`.
- `reach` ([`Reach`](#reach); optional): How close the user must be.
- `uses` (object, id of a [`channel`](channel.md) → [`Slots`](#slots); optional): The channel slots doing it occupies (03 §6.2). Carried for the action that does it.
- `time` ([time](../units.md#time) in `s`; optional): How long it takes, in the user's own time.
- `noise` (number; optional): How loud it is, as a factor for signals (15 §3). Carried for perception.
- `tools` (list of string; optional): The tool qualities it needs (16 §8.3), as written. Carried for package G6.
- `if` ([condition](../values.md#conditions); optional): Whether it can be done now: tested against truth when it is attempted, with `self` the user, `target` the thing and `here` the thing's cell.
- `shown_if` ([condition](../values.md#conditions); optional): Whether it is listed at all: a mind context of the user, read when a menu is made.
- `fail_text` ([text](../values.md#texts), or `null`; optional): What a refusal for `if` says. Left out, a sentence of the engine's.
- `do` ([list of effects](../values.md#effects); optional): What it does: effects with `self`, `target` and `here`.
- `default` (`true` or `false`; optional): Whether it is the one used when the thing is bumped into or clicked without a choice.
- `offered_by` (one of `"any"` ([`OfferedBy`](#offeredby)), or `null`; optional): `any`: offered by every target of its kind, where `shown_if` holds.

<a id="targetkind"></a>
### `TargetKind`

What an interaction is done to (16 §3.2): an element of a cell, or an entity (a device, an item, a creature). It decides the kind `target` is bound as.

One of:

- `"element"`: A floor, block or fixture.
- `"entity"`: An entity.

<a id="reach"></a>
### `Reach`

How close the user must be (16 §3.3).

Written as `held`, `same_cell`, `adjacent`, `network`, or `{ "range": metres }`.

Takes:

- a string
- an object: object, name → any JSON value

<a id="slots"></a>
### `Slots`

How many slots of one channel are needed (03 §6.2).

In data, a whole number of at least one, or `"all"`.

Written as a number of slots, or "all".

Takes:

- a string
- an integer

<a id="offeredby"></a>
### `OfferedBy`

Who offers an interaction besides what lists it (16 §3.2).

One of:

- `"any"`: Every target of its kind, where `shown_if` holds: examine, smash, climb.
